entities.name: Bartłomiej Bonk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bartłomiej Wojciech Bonk is a Polish weightlifter. He won the silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the men's 105 kg category with a total of 410 kg. He also competed at the 2008 Summer Olympics, but failed to score.
